notes.title: Brotherhood United 2.0 "Coop" mode available!
notes.content:
[b] Hi Myoubouh! [/ b]

Version 2.0 of Brotherhood United is finally available !

[Img] https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32889631/dd0d083678e83639111ce9dda448a95be153558a.png [/ img]

This version brings a big plus compared to the previous version. You can now play in cooperation with a friend in local ! Just update the game if you already own it, the update is completely free !

For those who have not bought the game, this release is an opportunity to offer the game with a 50% discount for 14 days from today.

The cooperation mode is slightly different from the solo mode. There are roughly more enemies to block your road and Bosses are a little more resistant.

[Img] https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32889631/3bc3d792606aebd836709a6c0975d2c16553ce11.jpg [/ img]

Proposing this update to you has not been an easy task and it asked about 8 months of work, but we are really happy to have managed to do everything possible to offer players what they expect in our view. more than an old-fashioned Run And Gun.

notes.title: Brotherhood United coop mode
notes.content:
New important information about Brotherhood United !

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32889631/dd0d083678e83639111ce9dda448a95be153558a.png[/img]

The game will receive in the near future a big update, which will be called [Version 2.0]. This new update will bring a new big feature.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32889631/3bc3d792606aebd836709a6c0975d2c16553ce11.jpg[/img]

We decided to work in a local co-op mode, so that the game could reflect the name it bears as well as possible.

There will be more ennemies on this mode and each Boss will be more resistant. The AI ​​of all of them will be adapted to take into account the second player in the game.

We continue to work on the title and some little things could be added as well in the future. The price of the game was increased in the evening (it went from 4.99$ euros to 7.99 $). The first buyers will of course be able to obtain this update completely for free too, so that they will not be penalized by this price increase, but rewarded for having supported us. It is thanks to early buyers that we can set up this new game mode.

We keep you informed of the progress of the two player mode !

notes.title: Brotherhood United [Update 1.1]
notes.content:
Some of you may have experienced some problems to got all the 3 Stars on two or three levels. We took time to correct that, and we improved in the same time the ennemi and bro counter. 

Now each area has it's own ennemi and bro to rescue counter. That allows the player to know better what is exactly missing to complete one area. 

We also added a "missed" counter for the ennemies and bro's that you forget in the level. When you get a miss somewhere it means that in the previous areas you forgot to save your friends or that you left some enemies alive. 

We really hope that these improvements will help you to complete Brotherhood United at 100%. And we deeply apologize for the inconvenience that this bug may have caused to some people. 

Have fun and if you have some questions don't hesitate ! ;)  

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32889631/dd0d083678e83639111ce9dda448a95be153558a.png[/img]

notes.title: The Brotherhood United steam page is online !
notes.content:
Hello Myoubouh's ! The Brotherhood United steam page is online and the game will be available in two weeks on Steam. 

Brotherhood United is scheduled for June 15. ;) 

The entire team of Myoubouh Corp wishes to thank you warmly for all your support. Brotherhood United is a game that is edited by our team. We did not design the game in its entirety, but we helped its developer to deliver the best product possible, and we are really pleased with the final result. The game is really fun, and it's an arcade experience like we really appreciate them.

We really hope you'll be able to enjoy this new 100 % arcade adventure.

See you on June 15th for the game release ! Don't hesitate if you have any questions. =D

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32889631/dd0d083678e83639111ce9dda448a95be153558a.png[/img]
